description.zh: 操作权限集合，格式：`权限组ID1:权限码1;...;权限组IDn:权限码n`，例如`1:1;1:2;2:1;2:2`。详细权限组及权限码含义请参见[ListAuthority](~~149409~~)。
description.en: The set of permissions to be granted to the role. The value is in the format of `Permission group ID 1:Permission serial number 1;...;Permission group ID n:Permission serial number n`. Example: `1:1;1:2;2:1;2:2`. For more information about permission groups and permission serial numbers, see [ListAuthority](~~149409~~).
